definition: the study of computers and how they work
description: A young woman in a blue top and blue trousers stands on a stepladder in a bright server room, colourful cables hanging around her neck. She plugs a yellow cable into a tall black server rack and smiles. Below her, a young man in a grey beanie holds a big bundle of cables and looks up at her, laughing. More cables run along the ceiling and lie under an open floor panel. The two look like students of computer science who are learning how computers and networks really work.

to clutch a bundle of cables
